# LLM Navigation Map

## Project

**Manifest** is a standalone framework project. Projects that connect to it
remain independent consumers and own their implementation and internal
workflows.
Entry point: `AGENTS.md`

## Directories

* `docs/` — project documentation. Manifest specification:
  `docs/manifest.md` (full) and `docs/manifest.compact.md`
  (compressed); project-level manifest with frozen decisions:
  `docs/project-manifest.md`. Project independence and publication rules:
  `docs/project-boundaries-and-publication.ru.md` (authoritative RU) and
  `docs/project-boundaries-and-publication.en.md` (EN translation).
* `docs/architecture/` — architecture documents and audits
  (architecture brief, decision registers, MVP/roadmap split, role
  model, integration audits, external dependency register:
  `docs/architecture/external-dependencies.ru.md`), the target
  Todoing integration contract (`todoing-contract.ru.md`, historical
  editions `contract-spec-final.ru.md`, `contract-spec-v3.ru.md`,
  `contract-spec-v4.ru.md`, `contract-spec-v5.ru.md`), and the
  Todoing task lifecycle clarification
  (`todoing-task-lifecycle-clarification.ru.md`) and connected-project
  structure proposal (`project-structure-design.ru.md`), and approved
  connected-project structure (`connected-project-structure.ru.md`).
  Russian editions are authoritative (`*.ru.md`); English versions
  (`*.en.md`) are translations.
  Historical decision records; do not delete.
* `docs/plans/` — plan files (stored compressed; `.ru.md` is authoritative).
* `workflow/` — OpenSpec user–agent interaction process
  (roles, 7 steps, gates). Entry: `workflow/README.en.md`.
  Temporary mandatory agent guide for connected consumers:
  `workflow/connected-agent-onboarding.ru.md` (authoritative RU) and
  `workflow/connected-agent-onboarding.en.md` (EN translation). It defines
  startup checks, component modes, OpenSpec ↔ Todoing mapping, agent
  responsibilities, lifecycle, and recovery until per-context-file generation
  is implemented.
  One-run consumer onboarding plan:
  `workflow/connected-agent-integration-plan.ru.md` (authoritative RU) and
  `workflow/connected-agent-integration-plan.en.md` (EN translation). It audits
  the consumer, configures enabled components, transfers agent context, and
  verifies readiness without creating tasks or publishing changes.
  Naming rules for files and directories:
  `workflow/naming-rules.en.md`. Structure of Markdown documents
  (metadata block, status list, section numbering):
  `workflow/file-structure-rules.en.md`. Rules for changing the
  metadata block (version, date, type, status):
  `workflow/file-metadata-change-rules.en.md`. Manifest
  workflow rules: `workflow/manifest-workflow-rules.en.md`.
  Commit message rules: `workflow/commit-rules.en.md`.
  temp/ folder rules:
  `workflow/temp-folder-rules.ru.md`. Project agent file
  (`agent-rules`): `workflow/agent-rules.ru.md`; accumulator draft
  with the full agent content material:
  `workflow/agent-rules-draft.ru.md`. Registry of connected
  projects: `workflow/connected-projects.md`.
  Roadmap (planned work; implemented items are marked):
  `workflow/roadmap.en.md`.
* `temp/` — scratch space (gitignored).
* `scripts/` — development infrastructure of the Manifest project
  itself (structure parser, verify script, pre-commit hook). NOT
  part of the framework distribution: never ship it in
  manifest-init `dist/`; connected projects do not use these files.

## Build

No build step; runs from source.

## Rules

* Workflow: `AGENTS.md`
* Project boundaries and publication: `docs/project-boundaries-and-publication.ru.md`
* Versioning: `VERSIONING.md`
* Releases: `releases.md`
* Commits: `commit-rules.md` (Manifest project itself); universal
  framework version for connected projects:
  `workflow/commit-rules.en.md`
* OpenSpec tasks: `openspec-rules.md`
* Access boundaries: `.llmignore` (read first)

## Notes

* Task-size calibration (measured on the sequential-ratio-compression
  run): doc task ~2-3 min, code task with scripted verification ~5-8 min;
  split by deliverable files; executor commits after each stage;
  heavy verification is its own task; >10 min → split in next revision.
